descriptions.1: Fragrant dried golden anchovy, a Da Nang specialty. Firm texture and natural sweetness — great fried with chili salt or as a snack.
descriptions.2: Da Nang beef jerky that is tender and savory. Mild heat and rich aroma — ideal as a gift or everyday snack.
descriptions.3: Refreshing ginseng pineapple tea with fragrant ginseng and gentle pineapple sweetness. Cooling and good for wellness.
descriptions.4: Premium dried squid from Central Vietnam seas. Thick, naturally sweet meat — delicious grilled or rehydrated and torn by hand.
descriptions.5: Thin, chewy Da Nang rice paper for pork rolls with fresh herbs. A famous street-food specialty of the coastal city.
